{{Quote|I was recruited by a man called Tyranus on one of the moons of Bogden.|Jango Fett|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
The '''moons of Bogden''' were a group of [[moon]]s that surrounded the [[planet]] [[Bogden]]. Sometime prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo]], [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] was hired by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Dooku|Darth Tyranus]] on one of the moons for access to his [[Clone template|genetic template]].<ref name="AoR JF">[[Age of Republic - Jango Fett 1|''Age of Republic - Jango Fett'' 1]]</ref> The [[Clone trooper|clones]] created from Fett's [[DNA]] later served as an [[Grand Army of the Republic|army]] for the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Episode II" />

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The moons of Bogden were first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]<ref name="Episode II" /> and were later seen in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''.<ref name="Bounty Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> They first appeared canonically in [[Age of Republic - Jango Fett 1|''Age of Republic - Jango Fett'' 1]], a comic in Marvel's miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Age of Republic]]'' and released on [[January 9]], [[2019]].
